Chief Barr. Dumo Lulu-Briggs
NDC Gubernatorial Candidate • Rivers State 2027
About The Candidate

The Man Behind
the Movement

“We will not be judged by the number of bricks and mortar we build — but by the number of households lifted from poverty into prosperity.”

Chief Barrister Dumo Lulu-Briggs — widely known as DLB — is a seasoned legal practitioner with over 27 years of post-call experience at the Nigerian Bar. A distinguished barrister, accomplished entrepreneur, technocrat, and grassroots mobilizer, he embodies a generation of leaders ready to transform Rivers State from the inside out.

As the Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of DLB Group — a conglomerate with strategic interests in oil & gas and marine sectors — Chief Lulu-Briggs has built a proven record of executive leadership, economic management, and job creation for Rivers people. His business acumen is matched only by his deep commitment to public service and community development.

A voice for federalism, democratic governance, and institutional reform, DLB has championed the rights of ordinary Rivers people across decades of political engagement. His candidacy under the NDC banner represents a bold, fresh alternative — free from encumbrances — built entirely on the aspirations of Rivers State.

Legal Expertise
27+ years as Barrister & Solicitor of the Supreme Court of Nigeria — grounded in justice and the rule of law.
Business Leadership
CEO of DLB Group — oil & gas and marine conglomerate driving economic growth in the Niger Delta.
Grassroots Mobilizer
Known and trusted across all 23 LGAs — from Andoni to Obio-Akpor — a true son of the soil.
Proven Public Service
Years of community empowerment, widows' support programs, and direct investment in Rivers lives.
Campaign Priorities

A New Agenda
for Rivers State

Six pillars of transformation — grounded in the real needs of Rivers people and backed by a clear vision of inclusive prosperity.

01

Peace & Security

Chief DLB will restore enduring peace across Rivers State — dismantling political violence, empowering community policing, and ensuring every Rivers person can live and thrive without fear.

02

Economic Growth & Jobs

Turning Rivers State’s vast natural and human resources into engines of mass employment — from industrial parks to tourism, agriculture to marine logistics — creating pathways from poverty to prosperity.

03

Education & Human Capital

Investing in world-class schools, scholarships, and vocational training — because the greatest resource Rivers State possesses is its young people. Every child deserves a quality future.

04

Good Governance

Transparent, accountable, responsive governance — ensuring Rivers State’s enormous revenues are invested directly in the lives of its people, not the corridors of power.

05

Infrastructure Development

Modern roads, bridges, waterways, electricity, and digital infrastructure — connecting every corner of Rivers State to 21st-century opportunities and driving private-sector investment.

06

Health & Social Welfare

Universal healthcare access, support for widows, the elderly, and vulnerable communities — because good governance means no Rivers person is left behind in our march toward prosperity.

Our Vision for Rivers

Rivers State Reimagined

A Rivers State where prosperity flows to every household. Where our oil wealth builds schools, not just mansions. A state at peace with itself and the world.

I

Tourism & Agriculture as Revenue Pillars

Rivers State’s land, creeks, and culture are untapped goldmines. We will transform tourism and agriculture into major economic drivers, creating thousands of jobs and diversifying beyond oil dependency.

II

Industrialization & Private Sector Growth

Without industries, there are no jobs. DLB will create an environment where businesses thrive — attracting investment, building industrial corridors, and absorbing the talent of Rivers youth.

III

From Poverty to Prosperity — For Every Household

Our administration will be judged not by buildings erected, but by households lifted from poverty into prosperity — and from prosperity into yet greater prosperity. This is our promise.

Be Part of the Change

Rivers State’s transformation starts with you. Join thousands of Rivers people standing on the ROCK with Chief Barrister Dumo Lulu-Briggs and the NDC.
